allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -in 5000,5100,8010,8090,5170 } | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort -Unique)

PowerShell($ok = $false; for \($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++\) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:8010/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Output \("HTTP " + $r.StatusCode\); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 } }; if \(-not $ok\) { Write-Output "서버 응답 없음" })
